description: Compares offers the user has explicitly asked to compare (by offer IDs from search_offers, or by category/city). If no IDs are given, returns up to 5 matching offers sorted by sort_by (default: the 5 lowest-priced). Returns offers with a card view. No paid or sponsored ranking. Operator-owned Aegis Scanner pricing.

offer_ids.description: Offer IDs to compare (from search_offers). If omitted, up to 5 matching offers by category/city are returned.

sort_by.description: Sort order: price (default), rating, or relevance. No paid placement.

name: compare_offers
title: Compare offers
